reading: The variable is a structural proxy, not an entailment class. Inserting or removing a diagonal operator preserves every computational-basis probability only when no non-diagonal operator follows it, so the stratum certifies CL3 at 12.8 percent rather than at a near-certainty. This is why the stratum is presented as a construction-confirmation arm and not as an entailed class, and why the non-diagonal stratum remains the estimate.
